detail.longDescription: A second PH4NTXM feature is now live on iGuru.gr, this time focused on the story behind the project. I talked about why PH4NTXM was created, the ideas behind disposable identity and OPSEC, some of the challenges during development, and where I want the project to go next. Thanks again to the iGuru team for giving the project space to explain the thinking behind it. https:// iguru.gr/mas-eipe-developer-to u-ph4ntxm/ # PH4NTXM # Linux # Debian # OS # Live # Privacy # Security # OpSec # InfoSec # Research # Tech # Technology
